title: PATCH UPDATE — V2.5.6
desc: A brand-new Fishing job at the docks, Discord alerts for turf/war/ship/advertisement events, and fixes for SWAT exit, bank robbery, and auto parts delivery bugs.
body:
Patch Update 2.5.6 is now live! This patch introduces a new Fishing job for everyone, brings in-game alerts straight to Discord, and squashes several outstanding bugs from the 2.5.5 update.

🎣 New Fishing System

  • A new fishing job is now available to everyone — civilians and faction members alike.
  • Head to the docks in the north-west of San Andreas, rent a boat, and head out to catch different types of fish.
  • Return to sell your catch and earn a variety of rewards!

🔔 Discord Alerts

  • In-game alerts are now sent directly to Discord in their dedicated channels: turf-alert, war-alert, ship-alert, and ingame-advertisement.
  • Grab the ping roles for these alerts in the alert-roles channel.

🛠️ Fixes

  • SWAT exit bug has been fully fixed, preventing it from ever happening again.
  • LS bank robbery vault bug has been fixed.
  • SF bank robbery bug has been fixed.
  • Auto parts delivery quest bug has been fixed.
  • ...and more.

This is a patch related to the 2.5.5 update — more patches may be released if needed. It is not related to the next main update we're currently working on.

Stay tuned! 🌞

title: SERVER UPDATE — V2.5.5
desc: The Ship returns with new rewards, a fully reworked War System, /factionmanagement for specialized soldiers, Deluxe Vehicle cases, a new anticheat, and the removal of Instant Jail.
body:
Server Update 2.5.5 is now live! The Ship makes its long-awaited return, the entire War System has been rebuilt from the ground up, and factions gain a powerful new management system for assigning specialized soldiers.

🚢 Ship Returns

  • The Ship returns with the classic 2024 style and rules everyone loved and missed.
  • New container prizes, more EXP, more Money, more Gold, and brand-new Cars.
  • Major anticheat changes prevent evaders from messing with or ruining the Ship quest.
  • Everyone can participate for now — no Legal or Illegal faction restrictions apply. Ship rules will be announced later by the Chief Administrator.

⚔️ War System Rework

  • The entire War System has been reset and completely reworked.
  • All faction territories have been reset — neither Army nor Terrorist factions own any territory. Factions must fight to capture and control them again.
  • Fast Travel removed — Soldiers and Terrorists must now use their faction vehicles to reach the warzones, making wars more dynamic and giving vehicles a much bigger role in faction warfare.

🛠️ Faction Management

  • New /factionmanagement system for faction Leaders and Deputies to assign specialized soldier roles.
  • Air Force (Army) — assigned soldiers gain access to military vehicles like the Hydra and Hunter for War activities.
  • Tactical Militia (Terrorist) — assigned soldiers can use heavy vehicles like the Rhino, even without being Leader or Deputy.
  • Only the Leader or Deputy can assign players to these roles.

💬 New War Chats & Recoloring

  • /rr — new chat exclusively for the San Fierro and Las Venturas Army factions.
  • /tt — new War Radio exclusively for the Jihadi and Al-Qaeda factions.
  • Several chats have been recolored (including public chat and DMs) so it's easier to tell which type of chat you're looking at.

🚗 Deluxe Vehicles Return

  • Two new cases, each containing one Deluxe vehicle — one uses Cash, the other uses Gold Dollars.
  • Both cases have a 100% reward chance, unlike other cases which have a 30% chance of no reward.
  • These Deluxe vehicles will not release with the dealership update — cases are the only way to get them for now.

🛡️ New Anticheat (Beta)

  • A new anticheat system has officially arrived.
  • Still in beta — it will continue to be updated and improved with every server update.

🗺️ Warzone Decorations

  • All 6 Warzones reworked with more cover, new areas, and closed-off sections, providing more tactical options and strategic positioning during Wars.

🚔 Instant Jail Removed

  • Players are no longer automatically sent to jail on death.
  • Cops must now arrest players through proper Roleplay, encouraging real interactions between Law Enforcement and players.

📷 Login Camera Fix

  • /fixcamera — forcefully disables the login camera animation, fixing camera movement issues on low-end devices that struggle to load it correctly.

P.S. — This update is the second part of the Summer Update 2.6. Everything added is still in Beta and being tested. Please report any bugs you find — more on the next part coming soon.

Stay tuned! 🌞

title: SERVER UPDATE — V2.5.1
desc: Last logout location & vehicle persistence, a fully fixed Walkie Talkie system, a redesigned HUD, Deluxe Houses purchasable with DP, and new faction tags.
body:
Server Update 2.5.1 is now live! This patch focuses on quality-of-life improvements, fixing the Walkie Talkie system, and introducing a cleaner HUD alongside a new persistent logout system.

📍 Last Logout Location

  • Players can now safely log out anywhere without violating the LTA (Leave to Avoid) rule.
  • On reconnect you will spawn at the exact location where you last disconnected.
  • Includes a GTA V-style character entry cutscene for a smoother, more immersive return.

📻 Walkie Talkie Fixed

  • The Walkie Talkie system has been completely fixed.
  • No more channel conflicts or privacy issues — communication is now reliable and secure.

🖥️ New HUD

  • The HUD has been fully redesigned, with unnecessary elements removed for a cleaner gameplay experience.
  • A custom HUD is now available on the PC Launcher, with Mobile Launcher support coming soon.

🚗 Last Vehicle & Last Location

  • Your last personal vehicle now automatically spawns at the exact spot where it was last parked or driven before you disconnected.

🏠 Deluxe Houses Available for Donation Points

  • House 976 — 70,000 DP
  • House 702 — 65,000 DP
  • House 142 — 60,000 DP

🏷️ New Faction Tags

  • New faction tags have been added for several organizations across the server.

🔜 Coming in the Next Update

  • A complete restructuring of the war system.
  • A full overhaul of the server’s roleplay systems.
  • Additional faction improvements and gameplay enhancements.

P.S. — This update is the first part of the Summer Update 2.6. Everything added is still in Beta and being tested. More information about the next part will be revealed soon.

Stay tuned! 🌞

title: SERVER MAJOR UPDATE — V2.5.0
desc: New Presidential, SWAT, SAN News and Vagos bases, deluxe houses, walkie-talkies and more!
body:
Europa Roleplay Update 2.5.0 is now live! This is one of the biggest updates yet, bringing brand-new bases, a full family system rework, a rebuilt sound engine, vehicle storage, economy rebalancing, and major roleplay improvements across the entire server.

🗺️ New Maps

  • Presidential Administration Base — brand-new interior and exterior.
  • SWAT Base — new exterior and relocated to a more tactical position near the ghetto.
  • SAN News Base — fully redesigned interior built for broadcasts, interviews, and professional media roleplay.
  • Vagos Base — moved to a safer location now that SWAT is no longer in the ghetto.

✨ New Additions & Changes

  • Deluxe Houses — 3 new premium houses, each with a unique interior, gated exterior, and its own garage interior.
  • Home on Wheels — a ONE OF ONE fully functional mobile house, with more perks coming later.
  • New Clothing Skins — additional skins added to clothing shops.
  • Global Chat System — new /p command with Faction, Family, and VIP tags, plus special tags for donators, deluxe players, and sponsors.
  • Dynamic Weather — every city now has its own weather and temperature cycle, changing every few paydays.
  • Anti Spawn Kill — 3 seconds of protection after entering or leaving interiors.
  • Anti Evader System — players under 1 hour of playtime cannot use weapons, plus improved admin-side monitoring tools.
  • Business Taxes — taxation reworked; unpaid taxes will cost you your business.
  • Black Market — a hidden marketplace selling exclusive illegal weapons and items.
  • Government Gates — secure faction gates added to every government faction.
  • New Cellphone System — contacts, calls, and messaging; /sms replaced with /dm.
  • New Player Tutorial — a tutorial screen to help new players learn the server.
  • New Administration System — completely redesigned from the ground up.
  • New Case Rewards — updated /cases rewards, including a new BMX and other rare vehicles.
  • Economy Rebalance — server-wide economic systems rebalanced for healthier progression.
  • Border Announcements — the server now announces which faction closes the borders.

⚙️ Optimizations

  • Removed multiple outdated and poorly optimized maps to improve server performance.
  • Removed the VIP Houses behind City Hall to reduce lag and fix the unloadable houses bug.
  • Planned for next update: reducing bots by 80% or removing them completely.

📍 Roleplay Improvements

  • Player Markers Removed — locations are no longer visible on the map, reducing metagaming.
  • Walkie-Talkie System — private channels with locking, custom names, member management, and channel panels.
  • Complete Sound System Remake — rebuilt from scratch with over 500 songs on the radio.
  • Europa Streaming Radio — a 24/7 in-game station featuring multiple music genres.
  • Car Radio Rework — passengers and nearby players can now hear vehicle radios.
  • BoomBox Rework — bug fixes plus new features and realistic distance-based audio.
  • /spy — FBI agents can now operate undercover using temporary identities.
  • /rankup Removed — promotions are now entirely in the hands of faction management.
  • Entry Questions — police applicants must answer basic questions right after selecting the faction in the Room of Fate.
  • /removemask — officers can remove masks from restrained suspects to reveal their identity.

🚗 Vehicle Improvements

  • Car Trunk System — persistent vehicle storage for weapons, drugs, tools, medkits, masks, and more.
  • Stock Vehicle Option — restore any vehicle to its factory appearance from tuning salons.
  • Complete Mask Rework — masks now hide identity and replace names with random anonymous identifiers.
  • DM Zone Restored — the classic DM Zone system and its original commands are back.

👨‍👩‍👧 Family System Rework

  • Family Deluxe House — families can link houses, including deluxe houses, so only family members can access the gates and garages.
  • Family Transfer — owners can now transfer leadership, with improved management dialogs.

...and much more. Some features may receive further tweaks in upcoming patches.

Thank you for supporting Europa Roleplay! 🚀

title: MEDIA EVENT — SERVER SHOWCASE CHALLENGE
desc: Create a high-quality showcase video of the server and compete for massive rewards. Best videos selected by the Media Team.
body:
The Media Department is excited to announce a new content creation event for all creators! This is your chance to showcase the server, highlight its best features, and compete for huge rewards.

📹 Event Task

Create a high-quality showcase video of the server. Your video must:

  • Be at least 3 minutes long
  • Be uploaded in HD quality
  • Showcase the server's major updates, features, systems, and gameplay
  • Be engaging, informative, and well-edited
  • Include a thumbnail and follow all media requirements

🏆 Rewards

  • 🥇 1st Place: 3000 DP
  • 🥈 2nd Place: 2000 DP

The best and most well-made videos will be selected by the Media Team.

📌 How to Participate

  1. Create your showcase video
  2. Upload it to YouTube
  3. Open a Media Ticket in the Media Discord
  4. Submit your video link for review

📅 Start: June 1st  |  End: June 7th

This is a great opportunity to promote the server, attract new players, and earn massive rewards.

Good luck to all participants! 🎬

title: TEAM DEATHMATCH EVENT
desc: 4 teams, 3v3 rounds, one winner. Deagle & M4 only. 150 GB prize pool split among the champions.
body:
Get ready for an intense and thrilling battle between teams. Each team consists of 3 members. Only the sharpest skills will help you survive in this Deathmatch.

🔴 Event Format

4 Teams will fight in rounds (3v3). The 2 winning teams from the 1st round (semi-finals) will face each other in the final round. The winner of the final will receive the prize. 🏆

💰 Prize Pool

  • 🥇 1st Place: 150 GB (50 GB each member)
  • 🔫 Weapons: Deagle and M4

📜 Rules

  • No leaving the arena once the match starts.
  • No using any other weapons or hacks — immediate disqualification.
  • Medkits & drugs are not allowed for healing during the event.
  • Fight fair and respect the event staff.
  • Mask is not allowed during the fight.
  • All server rules apply.

Breaking any of these rules will lead to your team's disqualification and punishment accordingly.

📥 How to Join

Get your best players and DM Nrg_Aguilar with the names of your 3 team members before slots are full. Only 4 teams will be accepted — first come, first served.

📅 Date: June 4th, 2026

⏳ Start Time: To be announced

Don't be late — the battle will be quick and deadly! ⚡

title: SERVER MAJOR UPDATE — V2.2.0
desc: A complete DMZone overhaul, new Border System, police & terrorist improvements, 120+ new animations, major bug fixes, and significant map updates.
body:
Europa Roleplay Update 2.2.0 is now live! This update brings a massive set of improvements across gameplay systems, maps, law enforcement, and more. Note: most features in this update are currently in Beta.

🔧 Bug Fixes

  • Fixed San News broadcasts not displaying correctly for all players.
  • Fixed seed plants not being registered properly.
  • Fixed rental bike notification messages upon confirmation.
  • Fixed persistent jail bug causing incorrect teleports after sentences.
  • Fixed checkpoint detection for Street Racer and Car Thief quests.
  • Introduced anti-farm mechanism for the Builder job.
  • Added cooldown system to Gang Quests to prevent reward abuse.
  • Reduced CityHall-related server lag by approximately 60%.
  • Various additional small bug fixes.

🗺️ Map Updates

  • Added new exterior for LSHD.
  • Added new market decoration and new CityHall exterior mapping.
  • Reintroduced the 2024 LS Bank Park mapping.
  • SAPD Exterior rebalanced to reduce lag and visual bugs.
  • Casino map, a business near CityHall, and a major lag-causing map near SAPD have been removed for optimization.

⚔️ DMZone Complete Overhaul

  • DMZone system completely rebuilt with structured competitive modes and new maps.
  • Anti-CBug Mode: C-Bug fully disabled server-side — mobile and PC compete together equally.
  • Three new maps: The Desert, The Zoo, and PVP Area.
  • Mobile vs Mobile / PC vs PC separated competitive modes.
  • Persistent kill tracking — use /mykills to check your DMZone kill count.

🚓 Border System — New Feature

  • Dynamic Border System adding political and economic roleplay.
  • Players must pay Border Taxes when crossing certain borders, adjustable by the President.
  • Police officers can open and close borders — crossing a closed border is a criminal offence in-character.

👮 Police, Terrorists & Kidnapping Improvements

  • Backup System: Officers can call for backup via /panic.
  • FBI: /spy reworked — now auto-gives faction clist and adds you to their member list.
  • SWAT receives spas12 and sniper from rank 8+.
  • Hitmen receive a knife from rank 8+.
  • Terrorists can now use /takephone when kidnapping a tied player.
  • Officer department/radio chat now appears above their character in-world.

🎭 New Animations

  • 40+ new player state animations.
  • 20+ new faction state animations.
  • 60+ general animations accessible via /listanims.

Features in Update 2.2 are mostly Beta and may be updated soon. A restart is required for some changes to fully apply.

Thank you for your patience and support — Europa Roleplay Team

title: SERVER MAJOR UPDATE — V2.1.5
desc: A massive overhaul featuring new faction interiors, civilian jobs, criminal quests, and significant bug fixes.
body:
We're excited to announce that the latest major update for EU:RP is now officially live! This update includes a large number of improvements, fixes, and brand-new features designed to enhance the overall roleplay experience.

🆕 New Features

  • Added new interiors for Yakuza, LCN, Russian Mafia, and Jihadi
  • New delivery quests (Parts/Drugs) for Ghetto Gangs
  • New Hitmen quests: Data and Corpse delivery
  • New civilian jobs: Factory, Miner, Sawmill, and Construction Site
  • Criminal car theft quest (Police will be notified!)
  • Added Neon tuning options and functional /tazer gun
  • Real-time location tracking via /finds

🛠️ Changes & Fixes

  • Warzones locked to Level 3+ and verified players
  • Fixed recurring godmode bug after death
  • Fixed Pilot kicks and balanced rewards
  • Resolved family promotion and Presidential rank bugs
  • Fixed UI visual bugs and syncing/performance issues

"Rome wasn't built in a day, but we're taking steps forward toward a better future."

Thank you for supporting Europa Roleplay!
